title: Gassed Out: a drone survival game I'm building with Claude Code in Unity. War-torn procedural town, models made by scripts in headless Blender
author: Admirable-Struggle78
selftext:
Solo dev here. Gassed Out is a first-person survival game: you're stuck on a roof above a city drowned in toxic gas, and a battered drone is the only way to get food, water and parts. The clip is real gameplay from today's build.

How AI fits into it:

\- Code: Claude Code writes basically all of the C# (Unity 6, URP). I play, describe what's wrong, it changes the code. An offline compile check runs in seconds, and a full Windows build runs in the background at low priority so I can keep using the PC.

\- Models: no image or 3D generators. Buildings, furniture and props are Python scripts driving headless Blender (written by the AI) that export into a model library. Same for the itch page art: real game frames and open-source fonts.

\- Town: procedural and streamed, 13×13+ blocks. This build added war damage (blown-off tops, blast holes, collapsed roofs, craters, burnt cars) and corridor-first floor plans, because the old room packing made hallways that went nowhere.

\- Feedback loop: a tester reports a bug on Discord, I paste it in, and it's usually fixed in the next build. Builds 6 and 7 were mostly tester reports.

What didn't work: the voxel GI I tried glowed and leaked light through walls, so it's off for now. A WebGL build washed out every surface and crashed browser tabs, so it's down too.

That feedback loop is only as good as the people testing, so I'm looking for more playtesters. Free, Windows: [https://allarakik.itch.io/rotor-rescue](https://allarakik.itch.io/rotor-rescue)

Playtest Discord (new builds land there first): [https://discord.gg/xbxbEweQjY](https://discord.gg/xbxbEweQjY)
